title: CM to US Shoe Size Converter
primaryKeyword: CM to US Shoe Size Converter
metaDescription: Convert foot length in centimeters (cm) and Mondopoint millimeters directly to US shoe sizes for athletic and casual footwear.

faq.question: What is 27 cm in US shoe size?
faq.answer: A 27 cm foot length is equivalent to a US Men's 9 (or EU 42.5), and a US Women's 10.5.

faq.question: Is CM measurement the most accurate for shoes?
faq.answer: Yes, Japanese sizing and Mondopoint represent actual foot length in centimeters and millimeters, making them the most objective basis for cross-brand fit.

faq.question: Is foot length measured in the morning or evening?
faq.answer: Always measure your foot length in the late afternoon or evening, as feet expand by up to half a centimeter throughout the day.

directAnswer: To convert foot length in centimeters to US shoe size, add 1.5 cm of clearance allowance to your bare foot length. A 26.5 cm foot length requires a 28 cm shoe last, translating directly to a US Men's size 10 or Women's size 11.5.
